XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
With reference to the replacement prescribed in the mileage of the Official Service or through the warning on the instrument panel

The Engine Oil and Filter must be replaced more frequently under the following conditions:

  • Intense city use (idling)
  • With mileage of less than 10,000 km/year

Every 1,000 km or before long journeys, check and, if necessary, top up:

  • engine coolant level
  • brake fluid level
  • windscreen washer fluid level
  • tyre pressure and condition


    Every 3,000 km, check and, if necessary, restore: engine oil level.

    Every 10,000 km or when the warning light comes on (only for diesel engines): drain the condensation water from the fuel filter.

If the car is mainly used in one of the following particularly severe conditions:

  • towing a trailer or caravan
  • dusty roads
  • short (less than 7-8 km) and repeated journeys with outside temperatures below zero
  • engine frequently idling or driving long distances at low speeds, or in the event of prolonged inactivity


    The following checks must be carried out more frequently than indicated in the official service schedule:

  • check the condition and wear of the front disc brake pads
  • check the cleanliness of the bonnet and boot locks, clean and lubricate the levers
  • visual check of the condition of: engine, gearbox, transmission, rigid and flexible sections of the pipes (exhaust - fuel supply - brakes) rubber elements (caps - sleeves - bushings, etc.)
  • Check battery charge and fluid level (electrolyte)
  • Visual inspection of accessory drive belts
  • Check and, if necessary, replace engine oil and filter
  • Check and, if necessary, replace pollen filter
